message: Add multi-unit heat pump support and backup heat cost modeling
subject: Add multi-unit heat pump support and backup heat cost modeling
body:
EnergyAnalysisCalculator now accepts a unitCount parameter that scales
heat pump capacity linearly, allowing contractors to model two or more
identical heads covering a larger load. A new backupCostForUnmet()
helper prices the unmet portion using the selected backup type (existing
system, electric resistance, or none), applying the correct fuel rate and
efficiency for each case.

EnergyAnalysisModels gains BackupHeatType enum, unitCount on
ComparisonSystem, and backupCost/coverage fields on MonthlyEquipmentResult.
All new fields use decodeIfPresent so existing saved settings load without
error. EnergyAnalysisSettings in Models.swift adds systemUnitCountRawValues
and backupHeatType with the same backward-compatible pattern.

EnergyAnalysisView wires up the new unit-count stepper and backup heat
picker, saves state on scene background transition, and cleans up duplicate
onChange handlers.

GitHub Actions workflow updated to emit richer commits.json using Python:
each entry now includes subject, body, changed file list, and proper
JSON escaping instead of the fragile shell sed approach.

message: Improve energy analysis accuracy, COP reporting, and UI validation
subject: Improve energy analysis accuracy, COP reporting, and UI validation
body:
- Fix heat pump COP display: replace time-averaged interpolated COPs with
  energy-weighted effective COP (deliveredBTU / kWh / 3412) for both monthly
  and seasonal totals, giving a physically correct reported efficiency
- Extend COP curve cold-end to -20°F (1.2) for smoother subzero interpolation;
  add comment clarifying this is a generalized planning curve, not spec data
- Add date range validation: disable analysis and show inline red message when
  startDate > endDate
- Replace hardcoded season footer text with dynamic formatting from
  WeatherService.defaultHeatingSeasonRange()
- Show propane price row only when propane is relevant (consistent with other fuels)
- Monthly cost cells now show cents ($x.xx); season totals remain whole dollars
- Cache DateFormatter and shortMonthSymbols as static lets to avoid per-render allocs
- Add comment documenting Manual J indoor-setpoint vs energy-analysis consistency
- Fix WeatherService date handling: use local calendar for API date strings and
  clamp returned records to the exact selected range

message: Make Gas Pipe Sizer chart-driven to prevent unsupported configurations
subject: Make Gas Pipe Sizer chart-driven to prevent unsupported configurations
body:
availableFuelTypes and availableSystemTypes are now derived from loaded
chart data rather than enum allCases, so the pickers only show options
that have a backing chart. selectFirstValidConfiguration() snaps all

in both the configuration section and the calculate footer.

message: Add psychrometric cooling loads, climate-aware infiltration, and DHW fixture-driven system sizing
subject: Add psychrometric cooling loads, climate-aware infiltration, and DHW fixture-driven system sizing
body:
Manual J Calculator:
- Add psychrometric data per climate zone (outdoor/indoor grains, enthalpy)
- Infiltration latent load now uses Q = 0.68 × CFM × Δgrains (climate-aware)
- Basement rooms use 25% volume for infiltration (above-grade only)
- Split internal gains into lighting, appliance sensible, and appliance latent
- Add room-level SHR (sensible heat ratio) and cooling CFM
- Add heating CFM for heat pump (35°F rise) and furnace (55°F rise)
- Add system-level enthalpy-based CFM: Q_total / (4.5 × Δh)
- Slab floor loss uses perimeter-based formula with F=0.73
- Add ventilation placeholders in structs for future ASHRAE 62.2

DHW System:
- DHW Fixture Sizer now persists data per project (DHWFixtureSizerData model)
- DHW System Sizing pulls all inputs from Fixture Sizer (no manual entry)
- Shows "No Fixture Data" prompt when fixtures not yet entered
- Remove install cost references from all water heater options and reports
- Add DHWSizingData and DHWFixtureSizerData Codable models with migration

Views:
- Project dashboard shows both DHW Fixture Sizer and DHW System Sizing links
- Room detail shows heat pump/furnace CFM, SHR, and room cooling CFM
- Project analysis shows enthalpy-based airflow alongside sensible airflow
- Project analysis shows humidity grains data per climate zone
- Settings version now reads from bundle instead of hardcoded string
